name: Neminuyemost
source:
Have you ever had the feeling that all stories are confined to one place - the camp? Felt that a possible scenario where Semyon either doesn't end up in the camp or actually makes it to his college reunion is simply unfeasible?
What if it was? Delve into the same depths of Semyon's routine to find out.
Was Semyon able to fulfill his potential in life? Will he be able to?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3347294521]Steam[/url]]
